text: The Meridian Bridge across the Selune river was completed in 1873. [Source: estate:meridian-docs:m-1]. Its span is 240 meters, the longest in the county at completion. [Source: estate:meridian-docs:m-2]. The bridge's construction was funded by the county treasury. [Source: estate:meridian-docs:m-1]. The original design was by a firm from Larkhall. [Source: estate:meridian-docs:m-2].
